name: cinematic-video
description: Turns a story, scene, or dialogue-free action brief into a multi-scene cinematic video with a LOCKED character and style, generated via Seedance reference-to-video with native engine audio (no narration), through the identity-first spine: plan → character+style lock → shot list → r2v pass(es) → assembly → verified delivery. Use when: "make a cinematic / short film / character short", "keep the same character across shots", "animate this character through a story/fight", any brief-to-finished multi-shot character piece without narration. Chain: a creation workflow — it orchestrates the domain skills (style-system, frame-craft, video-prompting, assembly-qc) and owns the project's plan.json + per-step artifacts; voice-timing is NOT in this chain. NOT for: narrated explainers (use explainer-video), a single still (frame-craft directly), animating one existing still (video-prompting), fixing/mixing an existing edit (assembly-qc), or kinetic typography / motion graphics (hyperframes' motion-graphics).
